summary: 28/30 requirements pass. Documentation quality is high: all four per-file sections are substantive and differentiated, INDEX fragments match DETAIL content exactly, functional module names are used throughout, dependency descriptions name specific functions and their purpose, and the Mermaid graph is accurate. The single critical failure is source file coverage at 7.98% (42/526 files), far below the required 80% threshold. The Agent explicitly acknowledged this shortfall and rationalized it as acceptable due to FastAPI's large number of tutorial variant files — a direct violation of SKILL.md's unambiguous HARD STOP instruction. No Skill documentation defects were found; the coverage gate instructions are clear and correct. The root cause is Agent non-compliance. The fix is minimal: add Skill guidance on handling tutorial-variant repos so the Agent has a compliant path to coverage rather than a rationalization path around it.
